$description: Kuzey Kapısı (The North Gate) — 3-tier color token architecture: Primitive → Semantic → Component. Brand brief: Sinop / antique Sinope, the stone fortress, the fisherman's harbor, Diogenes' lantern searching for an honest man, the lighthouses along the coast. Signature motif: FENER IŞIĞI (lantern light). Per this toolkit's convention (.claude/rules/tokens-and-color.md → 'Dark Mode Strategy'), top-level 'semantic' holds the LIGHT/day values and 'dark' holds the night override — even though the shipped app defaults to dark (see ui/theme/Theme.kt, karanlik=true). All pairings measured with scripts/contrast.py — ratios recorded per-token, not assumed.

primitive.$description: Raw brand palette — never referenced directly in components

lacivert.$description: Night-sea navy — the base of the dark palette.

600.$description: Recessed surface — form fields, list rows

deniz.$description: Deep-sea blue — secondary dark surface family.

400.$description: Most-elevated surface — open menu, selected card

600.$description: Elevated surface — dialog shell, sticky header

fener.$description: FenerAlevi — lantern-flame amber. The single primary accent. Restricted: hover/active state, primary button fill, focus ring, glow. Never a wide fill.

700.$description: Deepened for light-mode text/icon use on paper backgrounds

900.$description: Amber-tinted container — primary container bg on dark

tas.$description: TasBeyazi — quarried-stone white. Light background / text-on-dark.

sis.$description: SisGrisi — harbor-fog gray, secondary text. Brief specified #7C8B93; brightened to #93A3AA so ONE token clears AA 4.5:1 on every dark surface tier (bg/card/recessed) — see contrast log below. POUR outranks the literal brief hex per CLAUDE.md decision framework.

yosun.$description: Yosun — moss green. Narrow accent: 'doğa' (nature) category badge/point only.

300.$description: YosunAcik — readable badge text/icon on dark surfaces

sinop.$description: SinopKirmizisi — Sinop red. DAR ROL: only admin destructive/irreversible actions, and the Tescilli Ürünler category seal detail. Nowhere else.

700.$description: SinopKirmizisiDerin — light-mode text, and dark-fill onDestructive contrast anchor

kehribar.$description: Kehribar — a dusty brick-amber reserved ONLY for the error/warning semantic. Deliberately a different hue path from both fener (accent) and sinop (destructive) so no two intents share a value (Token-by-intent, non-negotiable #1).

cizgi.$description: Border/divider family, split into decorative (sub-3:1, by design) and essential control boundary (≥3:1 UI).

dark-strong.$description: 3.18:1 on deniz.500, 4.90:1 on lacivert.600 — essential control borders

gun.$description: Light-mode surface tiers (day counterpart of lacivert/deniz).

semantic.$description: LIGHT / day palette (toolkit convention: semantic = light default). Day counterpart of the brand — paper-warm surfaces, deepened accent for text use. Not yet the app's shipped default; see 'dark' below for the palette that actually ships.

primary.$description: 4.93:1 on tas.50 as text/icon; fener.400 stays the fill with lacivert.500 text on top

destructive.$description: 7.18:1 on tas.50 — DAR ROL, admin delete only

tertiary.$description: Same tier as secondary — this app has no de-emphasized third text tier

link.$description: External-action text (e.g. 'Rotayı Google Maps'te Aç') — reuses the deepened accent

on-action.$description: 8.25:1 on action.destructive (sinop.700); action.primary fill uses lacivert.500 on top instead — see component.button.primary-text

component.$description: Component-scoped tokens — use in component implementations

primary-text.$description: 7.87:1 on fener.400 — accent fill always takes dark text, never light-on-light

destructive-text.$description: 4.88:1 on sinop.500 (dark), 8.25:1 on sinop.700 (light) — its own token since the destructive fill is dark and needs light text, unlike the amber primary fill

tescil-seal-mark.$description: Tescilli Ürünler seal detail — the OTHER narrow use of sinop, alongside admin-destructive

dark.$description: NIGHT palette — this is the app's shipped default (Theme.kt karanlik=true). 'Gece denizi': deep navy background, lantern-flame amber restricted to accent/hover/glow, Sinop red held to its two narrow roles.

primary.$description: 7.87:1 on background — hover/active/primary-button fill only, never a wide area

destructive.$description: DAR ROL — admin delete/irreversible actions only

nature-badge.$description: Doğa kategorisi — 7.25:1 on background, 5.09:1 on card surface

secondary.$description: 6.51:1 on bg, 4.57:1 on card, 7.03:1 on recessed

on-action.$description: 7.87:1 on action.primary (fener.400) — the amber fill is light, so it takes DARK text, never white-on-amber. Destructive fill is dark red and takes its own white text: component.button.destructive-text.

strong.$description: 3.18:1 on card surface, 4.90:1 on recessed — essential control boundary
